==Usage==
This template is used to display a given search query and link to Wookieepedia's search function for it. It is intended for use on [[Wookieepedia:The Great Typo Hunt]].

<pre><nowiki>{{SearchWrap|query}}</nowiki></pre>, where ''query'' is a term to display and link to search for.

===Examples===
#<pre><nowiki>{{SearchWrap|assassin}}</nowiki></pre>
#*{{SearchWrap|assassin}}
#<pre><nowiki>{{SearchWrap|Alderaan}}</nowiki></pre>
#*{{SearchWrap|Alderaan}}
#<pre><nowiki>{{SearchWrap|honour}}</nowiki></pre>
#*{{SearchWrap|honour}}
#<pre><nowiki>{{SearchWrap|alchohol}}</nowiki></pre>
#*{{SearchWrap|alchohol}}
